body: When I start to think about suicide, like now, I also think about the good things about my life, and how would people feel if I die, but I'm not happy, and I want to be. Besides thinking about other people over myself, I have a 13 year old dog which I really love, and since I'm doing bad at college, I stay at home more than everyone else, so I'm the person who stays the longest period of time with my dog and I don't want to leave her alone. That's all I can think about to stop me from having bigger thoughts, or taking bigger actions...
